description: This file defines a custom exception class called BadRequestException within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the API v2 exception namespace. It extends the base PHP Exception class to represent HTTP 400 Bad Request errors.

classes.name: BadRequestException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing HTTP 400 Bad Request errors for the OrangeHRM API v2.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new BadRequestException with an optional custom message, error code, and previous exception for chaining.
